ICT Tip 💡:

The best setups on the lower timeframes will form around the higher timeframe weekly/daily levels.

The moment that you feel like moving your stop because the trade is going against you, or moving your TP because you're in profit, close the position.

You've already given in to greed.

This is how you train yourself to build discipline in your trading.

ICT Tip💡:

The morning session is a 4 hour window.

7am to 11am.

A Market Maker Model will form inside this time window.

Look for equal highs or lows to form after 7am to start the program.

ICT 2022 Model Simplified | Step by Step

The market doesn’t care about your last trade...

And neither should you.

Every trade is a unique moment in time.

Your last win doesn’t guarantee another.

Your last loss doesn’t mean you're cursed.

Approach every setup with a clean slate.

That’s how you stay objective.

ICT Tip 💡:

The Opening Price of every Hourly candle can be used in a Power Of 3 (PO3) context.

🔸️ If Bullish, buy BELOW the hourly open.

🔸️ If Bearish, sell ABOVE the hourly open.

Use 15/5 minute TF for entries.

You don’t need to catch every move.

You need to wait for your setup.

Most losses come from trying to force a trade that was never there.

ICT tip: 💡

Which FVG/OB is the highest in probability?

Answer: The one that forms inside of a killzone at a specific time.

After years of trading, you stop fearing the outcome.

You just press a button.

It either hits your target or it hits your stop.

Then, you move on to the next trade. 

And repeat it all again.

ICT Tip 💡:

Strong moves come after tight ranges. (Accumulation)

Range expansion occurs after (Manipulation)

Sweep liquidity → shift in structure → displacement.

Then range expansion (Distribution) to opposing liquidity.

You’re more likely to fail and quit trading if you keep trying to make quick money.

Respect the process.

The money will come as a by product.

Focus on consistency first.

When I stopped chasing price and started studying time…

everything changed.

It’s not just about where price is going.

It’s when.

That’s how you filter false breakouts and understand when price will reverse vs continue.

ICT Tip 💡:

One of the best ways to find daily bias is the New Week Opening Gap (NWOG).

It forms between Friday’s 4:59pm close & Sunday’s 6pm open.

NWOGs stay sensitive for up to 5 weeks.

If NWOGs cluster in the same area, it's a powerful draw.

Trade in that direction.

Consistency doesn’t come from watching more videos.

It comes from sitting with the charts every day.

Same time.
Same process.
Same routine.

Patience.

ICT Tip 💡:

The easiest way to filter bad trades?
Check if price has raided liquidity before moving.

No raid = no setup.

The market needs fuel before it chooses direction.

Wait for the raid, then trade the expansion that follows.

Let the trade setup come to you.

If you go hunting for it, you’ll see what you want to see.

Don’t be in a rush to give your money away to the market.

ICT Tip 💡:

The 1st FVG that forms after a raid on liquidity, on ANY timeframe, is a 1st presentation FVG and is high probability.

Overlap it with a DRT level, and you have gold.

Your strategy probably isn’t the problem.

You keep rushing into trades
before price gives you the setup.

Patience is the edge.

Wait for price.
Don’t chase it.

A wick is treated as a gap. If this wick overlaps with a FVG, this area can be treated as a balanced price range.

Master one asset.

Master one setup.

Master one session.

Consistency comes first.

The money follows.

The opening range gap (ORG) is the price difference between 4:14pm settlement price previous day and 9:30am opening price current day.

Anticipate price to trade to the CE (50%) of the ORG within the first 30min of the opening range post 9:30am, 70% of the time.
